entities.name: BMPR1B (O00238)
observations: Query sequence is 391 aa and matches reviewed human BMPR1B (UniProt O00238) at 98.9% identity and 91.6% query coverage (sequence-analysis result call_Wqtzz2owcs8ZVnOkUWZlncRZ).

Type I single-pass plasma-membrane BMP receptor and serine/threonine kinase; forms receptor complexes with type II receptors, which activate it by phosphorylation; activated receptor signals to SMAD transcriptional regulators.

Reference annotations include BMP7 and GDF5 receptor activity; associated biological processes include BMP signaling, response to BMP stimulus, cell differentiation, bone development and chondrocyte differentiation.
Sequence domain scan detected extracellular Activin_recp domain (residues 58–137), TGF_beta_GS region (205–232), and intracellular protein kinase domains (234–387).
